title: anthemis montana subsp. alpina
intro: Anthemis montana subsp. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Chamomile, is a subspecies of the Anthemis montana plant, which belongs to the daisy family (Asteraceae) and is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Chamomile are attributed to its calming and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to relieve symptoms of insomnia, restlessness, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, particularly chamazulene and bisabolol, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
